articles.title: CG Power statutory auditor S R B C & CO LLP to resign on Aug 14
articles.description: S R B C & CO LLP intends to resign as Statutory Auditor of CG Power and Industrial Solutions Ltd effective August 14, 2026. The move aligns with the auditor rotation at holding company TII, ensuring audit synergy for a subsidiary comprising over 50% of consolidated finances.
